panels.description: Alex presses VERIFY on the Measure; the instrument seals the reading. Keep the button, seal mark and hands clear.
Alex connects the verified Measure to the old-works node. White-and-amber lines carry the evidence outward; leave upper space for the confirmation sound.
Across Keel, public displays change to the verified water discrepancy while workers look up. Keep no crowd individually recognizable and leave display space clear.
At Site 6, the gate slams shut around Tomas as enforcement beams converge. Keep Tomas isolated but visible and leave upper darkness for his final line.
